text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, while integration tests make sure different parts work together correctly. Many developers use test-driven development, which means they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them find problems early and design better software. Tests also give developers confidence. When they know the tests pass, they can change the code without fear of breaking something. In short, testing is not a waste of time but a smart habit that leads to more reliable and higher-quality software.
